Description: Executes the active visual selection, or splits the SQL statement under cursor_byte via golib/parse/sql
Executes the entire buffer or fenced SQL block sequentially on the active AutoDB session
Focuses the AutoDB card to unlock the keystore, pick a saved connection profile, and inspect schema trees
Cancels the in-flight query or closes the active server-side session cursor
Opens an unsaved <schema>.<table>.sql draft tab pre-populated with SELECT * FROM ... LIMIT 100;
Copies the selected cells (or current cell) as tab-separated values (TSV) up to 16 MiB
Copies the selection as CSV with headers, typed JSON array, or GFM Markdown table
Streams all loaded rows to <file>.part and atomically renames over <file> (CSV or typed JSON)
Inserts all currently loaded rows as a formatted Markdown table at the editor cursor
Sorts loaded rows by column (NULLs last, exact decimal order, false before true)
Supports $$ dollar-quoting, array literals, JSONB operators, and PL/pgSQL blocks
Supports backtick identifiers, # and -- comments, and DELIMITER blocks
Supports bracket/backtick/double-quote identifiers and SQLite pragma/transaction syntax
Follows the connected AutoDB session dialect when active, or standard ANSI/PostgreSQL rules
